_readme: EDIT THIS FILE TO CHANGE THE TEAM SECTION. Nothing else needs to be touched.
Every field is optional except `name` — a blank field simply does not render,
so leave it as "" rather than inventing a value.
name       full name, shown on the card
role       e.g. 'Experiments & evaluation'; blank hides the line
affiliation programme or lab, e.g. 'KAUST Academy'
university home university, shown under the affiliation
email      shown as a mailto: link
cv         path inside public/, e.g. 'cv/your-name.pdf' (no leading slash)
ADD A MEMBER  : copy one { ... } block inside "members" and edit it.
REPLACE A CV  : drop the PDF into app/public/cv/ and point `cv` at it.
